criteria_addressed: C14-10: Decode JSONB fact decimals as BigDecimal without mutating the shared ObjectMapper.
C14-21: Preserve exact financial decimals through JSONB and receipt snapshot round trips; exercise exact, one-cent-under, and one-cent-over approval decisions against PostgreSQL.
decisions: Each decode call derives an immutable ObjectReader from the supplied mapper and enables USE_BIG_DECIMAL_FOR_FLOATS, preserving modules and configuration on the supplied mapper.
The test uses PostgresPersistenceSupport.start once in @BeforeAll, which applies migrations and exercises the runtime role grants with the real PostgreSQL container.
risks: The integration test requires Docker and remains unexecuted until coordinator verification.
